name: Bielefeld
author: pierreggt
description: Map of Bielefeld, Germany, from the city center to the surrounding Ostwestfalen-Lippe region (Gütersloh, Herford, Detmold, Bad Salzuflen, and 22 other municipalities). Residential population comes from the official 2022 census 100m population grid (Zensus 2022), with real German labor-market statistics (official employment counts and municipality-to-municipality commuter flows) anchoring Bielefeld and 26 of its 27 modeled surrounding municipalities.
data_source: Zensus 2022 (Destatis), Beschäftigtenstatistik BA + Pendlerrechnung der Länder (regionalstatistik.de/GENESIS-Online), OSM, Overture Maps
